pages.text: The $(item)Magical Pumpkin$() is a special block that can spawn custom girls when placed correctly.$(br2)This pumpkin has mystical properties that allow it to summon beautiful girls from another realm.

$(bold)Function:$()$(br)Place a $(item)Magical Pumpkin$() on top of a $(item)Copper Block$() to spawn a Coppie.$(br2)A Coppie will appear nearby if the conditions are met.$(br2)$(o)Note: Make sure there's enough space around the pumpkin for the girl to spawn!$()
Craft the Magical Pumpkin using a regular carved pumpkin and a poppy flower.
